Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

The authors acknowledge that NLI errors limit citation evaluation and cannot reliably detect partial support; automatically generated ELI 5 claims may omit valid answers, and the evaluated tasks omit math, coding and multi-hop reasoning.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

ALCE evaluates fluency, dataset-specific correctness, and citation quality separately; citation recall tests whether the concatenated cited passages entail a statement, while citation precision penalizes irrelevant citations.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

ALCE samples 1, 000 development examples from each of ASQA, QAMPARI and ELI 5; its human evaluation samples 100 examples from ASQA and ELI 5, with workers paid an average of $20 per hour.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

On ELI 5, Table 6 reports citation recall of 51.1 for ChatGPT VANILLA using five passages and 69.3 with reranking; the corresponding claim-correctness recalls are 12.0 and 11.4.
